title: Bolivia: the lowlands and the carnival, unit review
goal: Review the Chiquitos missions, Santa Cruz, Uyuni, the Chaco War and the Oruro carnival, with the grammar you used to talk about them.
grammar: review: ser passive, contrast connectors, hedging, past hypotheticals, relative clauses

items: I can review what I learned about the Chiquitos missions, Santa Cruz, Uyuni, the Chaco War and the Oruro carnival.
I can use the *ser* passive, contrast connectors, hedges, *si* + *hubiera* and relative clauses.
I can say what the 2024 lithium contracts were and where they stood in 2026.
I can say what was founded, expelled and restored with *ser* + past participle (review).
I can contrast two ideas about Santa Cruz with *sin embargo*, *no obstante* and *aunque* (review).
I can soften a claim about lithium with *parece que*, *según parece* and *podría decirse que* (review).
I can talk about a past that did not happen with *si* + *hubiera* + participle and *habría* + participle (review).
I can describe the dances and the people of the Oruro carnival with *que*, *quien* and *donde* (review).
